title: AuditEventCommonAttributes
description:
The common attributes for all audit events.

Introduced in Apple Business API 2.6.

actorName.description: Display name of the actor. Optional, may not be populated for all events.

actorType.description: The type of entity that performed the action.

eventDateTime.description: Timestamp when the event occurred (ISO8601 format, UTC).

groupId.description: Identifier for grouping related events. Optional, may not be populated for all events.

outcome.description: The result of the action. Optional, may not be populated for all events.

subjectName.description: Display name of the subject. Optional, may not be populated for all events.

subjectType.description: The type of entity that was affected.

type.description: The type of event that occurred.
